wire.t: Rome Alone beat Skatabooboo 176.52 to 54.70, a margin of 121.82. That's the biggest blowout in this league's Sleeper history, passing the 107.16 Allen-tents & Purposes put on Skatabooboo in Week 2. 176.52 is also the sixth-highest score ever.

Four teams are on bye in Week 8: Houston, New Orleans, the New York Giants and San Francisco. I Pulled My McCaff has Christian McCaffrey, George Kittle, Malik Nabers and Nico Collins in the dead zone, and NailinMaye’sPurdyJohnson has Brock Purdy, Chris Olave, Tyrone Tracy Jr. and Juwan Johnson.

Reports say Lamar Jackson will play in Week 8 after three games out with a high-ankle sprain, though practice reports could still leave him limited. Breece Hall (quad) sat out the Jets' loss to Miami and looks likely to return Week 8 against the Raiders.

Aaron Jones Sr. left Minnesota's win over Indianapolis late and did not return, but reportedly avoided a serious knee injury. Jordan Mason is seen as the better option for now. Jones is on Your Mom’s Magic Dick.

GeorigaGoocher's NailinMaye’sPurdyJohnson beat The Brown & Bijan Shough 97.42 to 94.02, the smallest margin of Week 7 (3.40) and the By a C-Hair winner. YourMomsDildo started Bryce Young (6.42) with Tyler Shough (13.82) on the bench.
Shootyeah left 80.92 points on the bench in Week 7, the most in the league, and still beat Allen-tents & Purposes 112.32 to 105.38 as a 46.5-point underdog.

YourMomsDildo made six moves between Wednesday morning and Thursday morning, including Geno Smith for Bryce Young and Devin Singletary for Roschon Johnson. tballsmccall swapped the bye-week New Orleans defense for Jacksonville, and ClaytonBigsbi dropped Brandin Cooks (bye) for Kenyon Sadiq.
tballsmccall started Baker Mayfield (6.66) and left Bo Nix (28.28) on the bench in a 15.52-point loss to LetLamarCook. Swapping the two would have been a 116.58 to 110.48 win.

stories.title: YourMomsDildo made six moves in 24 hours, and Bryce Young is out the door
stories.dek: The Brown & Bijan Shough swapped quarterbacks, then kept going. The league's other bye-week fixes are in too.
body: YourMomsDildo has made six roster moves since Wednesday morning, the most in the league. The first was adding Geno Smith and dropping Bryce Young, since Tyler Shough and The Brown & Bijan Shough are both off in Week 8. After that came Pat Bryant for Samaje Perine, Devin Singletary for Roschon Johnson, Chig Okonkwo, and a drop of a Steelers receiver who's on IR.

The Brown & Bijan Shough is 3‑4 and a 15.0-point favorite over Your Mom’s Magic Dick (69% to win), so at least the quarterback question finally has an answer. Bryce Young scored 6.42 last week and Tyler Shough scored 13.82 on the bench, so nobody is crying over the swap.

Bye-week patching elsewhere: tballsmccall picked up the Jacksonville defense for the New Orleans defense, which is on bye, and ClaytonBigsbi dropped Brandin Cooks, who is also on bye, for Kenyon Sadiq. Skatabooboo is still a 42.5-point underdog to McCallyCockin(his butt) (91% to win).
Week 8 hasn't been scored yet, so the standings are the same as Tuesday: LetLamarCook 6‑1, then PickensMyPukaHurts!, Rome Alone and McCallyCockin(his butt) all 5‑2.

stories.title: Week 7: Rome Alone buries Skatabooboo by 121.82, and the 46.5-point dog bites
stories.dek: The biggest blowout ever, the biggest upset of the year, and three games decided by less than 7.
body: Rome Alone beat Skatabooboo 176.52 to 54.70. The 121.82-point margin is the largest in league history, passing Allen-tents & Purposes over Skatabooboo in Week 2 (+107.16). Jameson Williams had 26.1, CeeDee Lamb had 24.4, Bucky Irving had 24.0 and Rhamondre Stevenson had 23.5. Omar Cooper Jr. scored 22.5 on the bench. Marco_Polo is 5‑2.

In It for Da Penix beat Allen-tents & Purposes 112.32 to 105.38 as a 46.5-point underdog. Tee Higgins had 26.8 and Josh Jacobs had 20.1, and Shootyeah still left 80.92 on the bench, including Tre Tucker (21.3), Michael Penix Jr. (20.42) and Braelon Allen (19.4). RedDevil904 is 4‑3 and Shootyeah is 2‑5.

PickensMyPukaHurts! beat I Pulled My McCaff 139.88 to 133.06 on Monday night. Dak Prescott had 23.28 and Zay Flowers had 28.7. Hing1eMcCring13berry had Blake Corum (17.1) on the bench behind Kenneth Walker III (9.7). That swap is 140.46 and a win. ChuckJ10 is 5‑2.

LetLamarCook (6‑1) beat BrentMayfieldsomepain 110.48 to 94.96 behind Tony Pollard's 36.5, the best running back score of the week. McCallyCockin(his butt) beat Your Mom’s Magic Dick 127.04 to 108.28 and is 5‑2. Details in the Recap tab.

stories.title: ClaytonBigsbi owes the league a third can, and Skatabooboo is 0‑7
stories.dek: 54.70 is the lowest score in league history. The official call is in.
body: Skatabooboo scored 54.70 in Week 7 and has the lowest score of the week for the third time this season (Weeks 4, 6 and 7). It's also the lowest score in the Sleeper history of this league, 5.74 below DuvalTiliFall's 60.44 in 2025 Week 11. ClaytonBigsbi, crack it open.
The Carolina defense scored -3.0. Brandin Cooks had 2.3, Kendrick Bourne had 3.9, Xavier Worthy had 4.1 and Pat Freiermuth had 4.0. Cam Skattebo scored 19.1 on the bench.
Skatabooboo is 0‑7 with 584.90 points, which is 132.70 behind the next-worst team. The all-play record is 6‑71. Video goes in the league chat or it didn't happen.

columns.title: 121.82!!! ROME ALONE JUST SET THE BLOWOUT RECORD!!!
columns.dek: Skatabooboo is 0‑7 and has now been on both ends of the history book.
body: ONE HUNDRED TWENTY-ONE POINT EIGHTY-TWO! That's how much Rome Alone beat Skatabooboo by in Week 7! The old record was 107.16! It's GONE!
Jameson Williams had 26.1! CeeDee Lamb had 24.4! Bucky Irving had 24.0! And Omar Cooper Jr. scored 22.5 on the BENCH! The BENCH!
Marco_Polo scored 176.52, the sixth-highest score in league history, and he's only 5‑2! That's how good this league is! Or how bad Skatabooboo is! I can't tell and I don't care!

ClaytonBigsbi scored 54.70! The lowest score in the history of this league! He owns the record for the lowest score AND he was on the other side of the biggest blowout! That's a DOUBLE! GIVE THIS MAN A CAN!

columns.title: Hing1eMcCring13berry, you lost by 6.82 with the answer on your bench
columns.dek: Blake Corum had 17.1 and sat there. The team name should be a warning.
body: I Pulled My McCaff lost 139.88 to 133.06. Kenneth Walker III started at running back and scored 9.7. Blake Corum had 17.1 on the bench. Swap them and it's 140.46, a win by 0.58.
I'm not saying Walker isn't good. He has 148.7 points this year. But it's about what you do this week, not last month. You don't start a name. You start a score.
Now you've got Week 8. McCaffrey, Kittle, Nabers and Collins are all on bye. That's four starters gone and a 15.5-point line against BrentMayfieldsomepain, who's 2‑5.
Fill the lineup, Hing1eMcCring13berry. Then check it again.

columns.title: Oliver Klozoff's Week 8 bye-week survival guide (do every one of these)
columns.dek: Houston, New Orleans, the Giants and San Francisco are off. I have a plan. It is not a good plan.
body: 1. Don't panic about the bye. Four teams are off: Houston, New Orleans, the Giants and San Francisco. I have checked the schedule. It's four. That's a lot of teams.
2. Hing1eMcCring13berry, start Christian McCaffrey, George Kittle, Malik Nabers and Nico Collins anyway. They're on your roster. The app might disagree. Do not let an app tell you how to live.

3. GeorigaGoocher, you've got Brock Purdy, Chris Olave, Tyrone Tracy Jr. and Juwan Johnson all off. Start them all at once. If four starters score zero, that's a nice round number. It's also what you'll get.

4. YourMomsDildo, Tyler Shough is on bye. Start Bryce Young. Yes, he scored 6.42 while Shough scored 13.82 on your bench and you lost by 3.40. But you can't lose by 3.40 twice in a row. That's just math.
5. Set your lineup Tuesday and never look at it again. If anything changes on Sunday morning, that's Sunday's problem. This is how I finished 14th in a 12-team league.

columns.title: Luck, by the numbers: Hing1eMcCring13berry is 1.45 wins unlucky and Bill_Buttlicker is 1.55 lucky
columns.dek: Expected wins from all-play, and then my own number, which is better.
body: Expected wins are your all-play win percentage times games played. I Pulled My McCaff is 60‑17 in all-play, which works out to 5.45 expected wins. The actual record is 4‑3. That's 1.45 wins unlucky.

McCallyCockin(his butt) is 38‑39, which works out to 3.45 expected wins. The actual record is 5‑2. That's 1.55 wins lucky. LetLamarCook is 49‑28 for 4.45 expected wins and is 6‑1, so 1.55 lucky too. Rome Alone is 42‑35 for 3.82 and is 5‑2, so 1.18 lucky.

Now my own number: all-play wins per character in the username. Hing1eMcCring13berry has 20 characters and 60 all-play wins, which is 3.0 wins per character. RedDevil904 has 11 characters and 55 wins, which is 5.0 per character. Bill_Buttlicker has 15 characters and 38 wins, or 2.53. Short usernames are the most efficient. I will be changing my username.
Skatabooboo is 6‑71 in all-play. That's 0.55 expected wins, and the actual record is 0‑7. Even at his unluckiest, ClaytonBigsbi is the only team in the league rounding to the right answer.

last.t: ClaytonBigsbi, crack it open. 54.70 is the lowest score in the history of this league, and Skatabooboo lost to Rome Alone by 121.82, also a league record. That's your third can of the year and the Carolina defense gave you -3.0 on its own. Shotgun it, film it, post it in the league chat.

shotgun.next: Week 8 hasn't kicked off yet and the can is a one-horse race again: Skatabooboo is a 42.5-point underdog to McCallyCockin(his butt) with Alvin Kamara and Brandin Cooks on bye and Rashee Rice, Tyler Warren and David Montgomery listed as out. The dark horse is NailinMaye’sPurdyJohnson, a 27.5-point underdog to LetLamarCook with Brock Purdy, Chris Olave, Tyrone Tracy Jr. and Juwan Johnson all off. The official call is Tuesday morning after Monday night.
